name: BodyTalk_2
short_caption: The robot opens both arms outward with palms up, then returns them to its sides.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture and raises both arms upward and outward. It extends its forearms with palms facing upward in a welcoming, open gesture while slightly tilting its head to the left. Finally, it smoothly retracts both arms back down to its sides, returning to the neutral resting position.
safety_notes: The arms sweep outwards to the sides; ensure a clear lateral clearance of about 50 cm on both sides of the robot.
